extraction.policy_summary: The Company has adopted an Equal Opportunity Policy in accordance with the RPwD Act, 2016, committed to empowerment of persons with disabilities and providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination on grounds of disability; the Code of Conduct states zero tolerance for disability-based discrimination, and a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Policy references creating a supportive environment for disabled employees.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: Total differently abled employees: 3 (2 male 66.66%, 1 female 33.33%); total differently abled workers: 15 (permanent 4, other than permanent 11), all reported as 100% male.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Premises/offices are largely accessible to differently abled employees, workers and visitors, barring a few locations due to safety considerations or facility design. Inclusive infrastructure at most premises includes elevators with braille inscriptions for visually impaired persons, ramps for mobility-impaired persons, touchless entry points, and wheelchair-accessible restrooms on the ground floor.
extraction.digital_accessibility_measures: Text-to-speech software is provided for visually impaired employees as part of the inclusive infrastructure facilities.
extraction.training_or_sensitization_programs: The Company conducts training on Indian Sign Language for employees to assist communication with deaf and mute colleagues, and lists a 'Sensitisation workshop for diversity and inclusion' as an action taken under its 2030 goal to improve diversity of gender, sexual orientation, specially abled persons, and regional diversity.
